struct Edge {
    int from, capacity, flow, cost;
    Edge() {}
    Edge(int f, int c, int fl, int co) : from(f), capacity(c), flow(fl), cost(co) {}
};

const int MAXN = 1000007;
vector<Edge> edges;
vector<int> graph[MAXN];

long long answer = 0;
long long shortest[MAXN];
int parent[MAXN], parentEdge[MAXN], inQueue[MAXN];

int source = MAXN - 2;
int sink = MAXN - 1;

int residual(int id) {
    return edges[id].capacity - edges[id].flow;
}

void findShortestPath() {
    for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; ++i) {
        shortest[i] = 1000000000000000000LL;
        parent[i] = -1;
        parentEdge[i] = -1;
        inQueue[i] = 0;
    }
    shortest[source] = 0;
    queue<int> q;
    q.push(source);
    inQueue[source] = 1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int v = q.front();
        q.pop();
        inQueue[v] = 0;
        for (int id : graph[v]) {
            if (residual(id) == 0) continue;
            int to = edges[id].from;
            int w = edges[id].cost;
            if (shortest[to] > shortest[v] + w) {
                shortest[to] = shortest[v] + w;
                parent[to] = v;
                parentEdge[to] = id;
                if (inQueue[to] == 0) {
                    inQueue[to] = 1;
                    q.push(to);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

void pushOneFlow() {
    findShortestPath();
    int cur = sink;
    while (cur != source) {
        edges[parentEdge[cur]].flow++;
        edges[parentEdge[cur] ^ 1].flow--;
        cur = parent[cur];
    }
    answer += shortest[sink];
}

void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap, int w) {
    graph[u].push_back((int)edges.size());
    edges.push_back(Edge(v, cap, 0, w));
    graph[v].push_back((int)edges.size());
    edges.push_back(Edge(u, 0, 0, -w));
}

int n, m, k, c, d;
const int timeLayers = 101;

void inputAndBuildGraph() {
    scanf("%d %d %d %d %d", &n, &m, &k, &c, &d);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
        int x;
        scanf("%d", &x);
        --x;
        addEdge(source, x, 1, 0);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < timeLayers; ++i) {
        addEdge(i * n, sink, k, i * c);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        int x, y;
        scanf("%d %d", &x, &y);
        --x; --y;
        for (int t = 0; t < timeLayers - 1; ++t) {
            for (int j = 0; j < k; ++j) {
                addEdge(x + t * n, y + (t + 1) * n, 1, d * (j * 2 + 1));
            }
        }
        for (int t = 0; t < timeLayers - 1; ++t) {
            for (int j = 0; j < k; ++j) {
                addEdge(y + t * n, x + (t + 1) * n, 1, d * (j * 2 + 1));
            }
        }
    }
}

void solve() {
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int t = 0; t < timeLayers - 1; ++t) {
            addEdge(i + t * n, i + (t + 1) * n, k, 0);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) pushOneFlow();
    printf("%lld\n", answer);
}

int main() {
    inputAndBuildGraph();
    solve();
    return 0;
}
